newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereins- und Westbank raised 96 risk provisions.
newsitem.headline: Vereins- und Westbank raised 96 risk provisions.

text.p: Vereins- und Westbank AG, a unit of Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG, said on Tuesday it had raised its loan loss provisions substantially in 1996.
Chairman Udo Bandow told reporters on Tuesday that the bank raised its provision by 30 percent to 148.5 million marks last year because of a significant rise in the number of company insolvencies.
Overall risk provisions, after allocations from the bank's liquidity portfolio, rose to 104.3 million marks from 99.41 million.
Vereins- und Westbank had on Monday reported a 2.2 percent drop in its 1996 net profit and said it would hold its dividend at 12 marks.
Bandow said structural changes in the overbanked German market would require more branches to be closed this year.
Around seven percent of the bank's customers already conducted their transactions electronically -- twice as many as the market average.
